description: Epic Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of great power?
Those exalted amongst the Dawn receive our greatest discounts! I encourage you to make a purchase.

clips.title: Progress

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good day, friend. It was a pleasure doing business with you.
